added_failures_note: The reviewed manifest declares baseline_suite and after_suite as null, so there is no declared arm pair. The count is the delta between the reviewed run's own revision-keyed gate logs: logs/s5-gate-pytest.log file (revision 9c2be60477ecd2e50bd57d05a8009b92b39cefd9) reports one failing id, test_the_bound_is_read_from_the_gates_control_file, and logs/s5-gate.log (revision f31419033df7b7f9c326e764f0d8536d782a94cb) reports six passed, so the head adds no failing id and retires the base's one.

assertion_review.conditions_for_failure: Restoring the pre-bound _slot_count (which only checks verdict=='paused') leaves over['worker_slots'] > 0 and over['worker_slots_reason'] None, so the three over-bound assertions redden; the paused-vs-wait test reddens the same way at :64-77.
assertion_review.independence: The waits are supplied as ledger admissions in _waits_ledger and the expectations (0 slots, 'gate_wait', capacity preserved) are independent of the closure code.

assertion_review.conditions_for_failure: Removing the five-minute filter in router.py:624-630 leaves gate_wait_p90_seconds at 40.0 and worker_slots at 0, reddening both assertions.
assertion_review.independence: The expectation None / open is independent of the filter expression.

assertion_review.conditions_for_failure: Dropping the control-file read or the wait_bound_seconds field leaves the setting at 30.0 and the document key absent, reddening the assertions.
assertion_review.independence: The 12.0 is read back from a file the test wrote, an independent source for the parse.

assertion_review.conditions_for_failure: Removing the validation branch in router.py:1247-1256 would let 0 through or raise instead of falling back, reddening the default assertion.
assertion_review.independence: The expectation is the module's DEFAULT_WAIT_BOUND_SECONDS constant, not the value under test.

assertion_review.conditions_for_failure: Disabling the closure makes the bounded arm publish no 'gate_wait' reason and the settled p90 exceed 45 s, reddening :160-166; this is what logs/s5-negative-control.log shows (3 failed).
assertion_review.limit: The window p90 is computed by percentile_or_none, the same function the router closes on, so an estimator regression moves both sides together.

evidence_limits: The reviewed manifest records baseline_suite and after_suite as null, so the added-failure count is taken from its two revision-keyed gate logs rather than from declared arms.
The node done_when's think-drop scenario is measured but is not the pass condition: both arms carry 35.25 s (logs/s5-probe-early3.log), so no bound-disabled window exceeds 45 s there.
The landed test measures the simulation's window percentile with the production percentile_or_none, so it is not an independent check of the estimator.
The gate ran with SLURM_JOB_ID unset as the done_when requires; the fragment's 'on all_debug' label carries no job id of its own.
No suite or mutation rerun was performed during this bounded read-only review; the reviewed negative-control log is read as recorded.

findings.text: blocking: settings() no longer assigns self._last_logged_settings (still declared at router.py:938), so the guard is true after the first read and every poll logs the full gate settings, an unimplied production behaviour change in a hunk that only meant to add wait_bound_seconds to the format string.

non-blocking: _window_p90s computes the simulation's window percentile with percentile_or_none, the same function router.py:624 uses to decide closure, so a regression in the estimator moves both the asserted value and the guard and the simulation test cannot catch it.

non-blocking: percentile_or_none duplicates the nearest-rank percentile owner imas_ambix/agent/lane_sim.py:161 _quantile, differing only in the None-versus-0.0 empty case, so the repository now holds two estimators of the same figure.

non-blocking: minute_samples and think_draws (line 361) are appended but read by no code in the repository, so they add per-minute and per-request memory growth to the parser-free simulation run without a consumer.

non-blocking: the fragment records the done_when's think-drop run at 35.25 s in both arms, so its bound-disabled negative control exceeding 45 s never occurs and the pass condition the fragment carries is the plan's margin-2.8 scenario, not the node's stated measure.

item_verdicts.diff: read both commits against 9c2be60477ecd2e50bd57d05a8009b92b39cefd9; five files add the ledger bound, its control-file validation, the simulation pass-through and the unit tests.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names a think-time-drop run whose bound-disabled arm exceeds 45 s, but tests/test_agent_lane_wait_bound.py:146-166 gates the plan's margin-2.8 run and docs/evidence/fragments/the-local-lane-delivers-its-plateau/s5.html:24-28 records the think-drop run at 35.25 s in both arms, so the gate asserts the plan's scenario and not the node's stated negative control.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to close the published worker slots while the windowed gate wait exceeds its bound; imas_ambix/agent/router.py:624-660 computes gate_wait_p90_seconds over the ledger's last 300 s and router.py:735-748 zeroes worker_slots with worker_slots_reason='gate_wait' while it exceeds wait_bound_seconds.
item_verdicts.manifest: the reviewed manifest records commits 4f1483976052d4639cd302a0d9a302e8b30a7133 and f31419033df7b7f9c326e764f0d8536d782a94cb, logs/s5-gate.log at 6 passed, its negative-control log, and null baseline_suite and after_suite arms.
item_verdicts.write_paths: every path in the diff (imas_ambix/agent/router.py, imas_ambix/agent/lane_utilisation.py, imas_ambix/agent/lane_sim.py, tests/test_agent_lane_wait_bound.py, docs/evidence/fragments/the-local-lane-delivers-its-plateau/s5.html) is inside the declared set.

justifications.durability: imas_ambix/agent/router.py:735-748 fails test_the_bound_publishes_no_slots_and_just_under_it_does_not and test_paused_and_wait_closed_documents_differ_only_in_the_reason when the closure is reverted, but tests/test_agent_lane_wait_bound.py:141 measures the window percentile with the same percentile_or_none the router closes on.
justifications.evidence: logs/s5-gate.log records 6 passed and logs/s5-negative-control.log records 3 failed, but logs/s5-probe-early3.log shows the node's own think-drop negative control at 35.25 s in both arms, so the gate measures the plan's margin-2.8 case instead.
justifications.fit: the added fields follow the document idiom at imas_ambix/agent/router.py:516-660, but imas_ambix/agent/lane_sim.py:357-361 lands collections that no other code reads.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_ambix/agent/router.py:624-660 and router.py:735-748 implement the bound, the single closure point and the one reason field the goal names.
justifications.reuse: imas_ambix/agent/lane_utilisation.py:489 re-implements the nearest-rank percentile that imas_ambix/agent/lane_sim.py:161 _quantile already owns, without extending it.
justifications.scope_discipline: every diff path is inside the declared write paths, but imas_ambix/agent/router.py:1154 deletes the old assignment of self._last_logged_settings, an unimplied change beyond adding wait_bound_seconds to the format string.
